approvedScope: Source-verified recommended rows reviewed by repository and functional purpose; exact-path coverage only. No featured status, new broad trust roles, combined crawl or publication.
reviewNotes: Reviewed task purpose, source attribution, pinned packages and companion dependencies by repository. Held explicit derived skills and unavailable runtime components; ordinary external product APIs/CLIs remain disclosed prerequisites.

manualReview.notes: Reviewed README provenance, source intros and package dependencies. Runtime library credits alone do not imply copied skills. Normal external service/CLI prerequisites are allowed, while unavailable plugin profiles and explicitly adapted skill content remain held.
